title: OCC Clears Circle, Ripple and Others to Launch Crypto National Banks
summary: The OCC has conditionally approved five crypto firms, including Circle and Ripple, to launch national trust banks. The post OCC Clears Circle, Ripple and Others to Launch Crypto National Banks appeared first on Cryptonews .

title: Tech Support Scammers Stole $85,000 From Him. His Bank Refused a Refund.
summary: A retired lawyer lost the money in a tech support scam, a type of online fraud that is surging. Citibank said it couldn’t recover the funds, which criminals wired from inside his account.
